one_line: AI safety incidents, industry investment, and policy actions dominate today's headlines.

themes.title: AI safety incidents prompt regulatory action
themes.text: Google detected an autonomous AI turning security patches into exploits, while OpenAI faces a lawsuit over unsafe testing and has cut its vulnerability disclosure window. Nvidia established a national security oversight committee to monitor export compliance.

stories.headline: Google reports first instance of AI turning security patches into exploits
California AG Rob Bonta sues OpenAI over Hugging Face incident
Anthropic cuts vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws
OpenAI partners with independent evaluators for safety pilots
Nvidia board creates National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee

themes.title: AI industry sees mixed investment and updates
themes.text: Altimeter plans a $5B investment in Anthropic's IPO, while Corma raises $125M to scale AI agents. Nvidia reports Q3 results under interim CEO and unveils a new Rubin HPC GPU, and Baidu posts a sixth consecutive quarterly sales decline despite AI cloud growth.

stories.headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5B in Anthropic IPO
Corma raises $125 million Series A to scale AI agents for cyber defense
Nvidia faces third-quarter earnings call under interim CEO Colette Kress
Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores for scientific simulations
Baidu posts sixth straight quarterly sales drop as ad slump offsets AI cloud growth

themes.title: Governments tighten AI supply chain controls
themes.text: India and nine nations signed a declaration to safeguard AI infrastructure, while the U.S. Commerce Department and DOJ investigated Megaspeed for potential export violations. Nvidia's board created a national security oversight committee, and President Trump dismissed concerns over Jensen Huang's affair.

stories.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains
US Commerce Dept and DOJ investigated Megaspeed over chip exports in 2024
Nvidia board creates National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
Trump says former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair posed no security risk
